messages.subject: warning message reading imzML (converted from .RAW data format, Orbitrap)
parts:
Hi,

when i try to open imzML data, that have been converted from .raw data format, I got the following warning messages

treated_1 <- readMSIData("treated_1/treated_1.imzML", resolution=1, units="ppm")
reading imzML file: 'D:\M4I\Marco\treated_1\treated_1.imzML'
reading ibd file: 'D:\M4I\Marco\treated_1\treated_1.ibd'
detected 'processed' imzML
determining mass range...
detected mass range: 100.0001 to 999.9925
done.
Warning message:
In PositionDataFrame(coord = coord, run = metadata(info)[["name"]]) :
  rows of 'coord' + 'run' are not unique
do you know how can I solve this problem? I could analyze the data but I could not perform a peak binning or m/z aligment because the R get a fatal error

Thank you in advance,
best regards,
Marco

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: warning message reading imzML (converted from .RAW data format, Orbitrap)
parts:
They may be unrelated issues.

The warning shouldn't impact any pre-processing methods, as they don't rely on the spatial information. It is just letting you know that spectra with duplicate spatial coordinates exist in the dataset. This may cause issues with spatial methods, but shouldn't result in errors. This usually happens when the original spatial coordinates are in real-world units; converting to imzML requires the x/y-coordinates be on a regular pixel grid, which isn't always possible to do perfectly. The original coordinates are sometimes preserved in the pixelData() if they were included in the imzML using known userParam tags.

I'm not sure about the source of the pre-processing error without more information.

-Kylie

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: warning message reading imzML (converted from .RAW data format, Orbitrap)
parts:
For the pre-processing, I would start by trying a larger mass resolution and seeing if that avoids the error. Using a finer resolution than the data contains can cause issues.

-Kylie

messages.subject: Re: warning message reading imzML (converted from .RAW data format, Orbitrap)
parts:
Thank you very much Kylie for the explanation. Indeed, using a lower resolution ( I have used 10 ppm instead of 1 ppm) the alignment and binning work very well without any fatal error.
